name: Marta Sánchez Ibáñez
headline: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8 years of experience building machine learning solutions for e-commerce and fintech sectors. Skilled in end-to-end model development, from data pipeline design to production deployment, with a strong focus on delivering measurable business impact.

responsibilities: Lead development of predictive models for customer churn and demand forecasting
Mentor junior data scientists and review model design and code quality
Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy ML models into production using Docker and AWS
Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders
Developed classification and regression models for credit risk assessment
Built ETL pipelines to consolidate data from multiple internal sources
Performed exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to improve model accuracy
Automated reporting dashboards using Python and SQL
Assisted in cleaning and preparing datasets for analysis
Created basic statistical reports for internal business teams
Supported senior analysts in building visualizations and dashboards
